title: The Crash That Stayed Contained
subtitle: One worker dies while its siblings keep serving

brief.narrative: A native library segfault kills one worker process. Other workers continue because each process has its own virtual address space and OS-managed resources.
symptoms: Worker Process metrics diverge from the service-level symptom
The problem reproduces only under the triggering workload
Logs contain enough evidence to distinguish cause from consequence
brief.objective: Identify the root cause, select a production-safe fix, and explain the trade-off.

rootCause.question: Which root cause explains all of the evidence?

options.text: The failure boundary is a process, not a thread; memory is isolated between processes.
options.feedback: Correct. Processes provide isolation at higher memory and communication cost. Threads share memory and fail together inside one process.

options.text: Blocking I/O ran directly on the event-loop thread.
options.feedback: This choice does not explain the complete evidence or leaves the underlying correctness/reliability problem intact.
